newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL signs oil exploration deal with Syria.
newsitem.headline: MOL signs oil exploration deal with Syria.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company Magyar Olaj- es Gaizpari Rt (MOL) signed an exploration and production deal with Syria, the company said on Friday.
"MOL has an exploration permit in the 5,000 square kilometers Palmyra east block," MOL said in a statement.
It added that MOL, which has 100 percent ownership in the project, will start the first phase of exploration in 1997. The project will last 3 years and eight months.

"According to previous surveys, the company is optimistic about the potential of this area and Syria plays an important role in MOL's Middle-East exploration and production strategy," the company said.
MOL officials said the contract did not allow disclosure of further information on the deal.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange (closed until January 6) MOL shares closed on December 20, the last day of trading, at 2,000 forints, down 15.
